test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) in his bag

(B) kept

(C) the documents

(D) he
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **DBCA**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence starts with the pronoun "**he**," which is correctly indicated by **part (D).**
 
• Next, "**kept**" (B) follows as the action being performed by the subject.
 
• It is followed by the object "**the documents**" (C) to complete the meaning of the action.
 
• Finally, "**in his bag**" (A) concludes the sentence by providing the location of the action.

Therefore, the correct sequence is **DBCA.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1 (DCBA):** This sequence starts with "he the documents kept in his bag," which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 2 (****DABC****):** This sequence forms "he in his bag kept the documents," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** This sequence begins with "kept the documents he in his bag," which is ungrammatical.
